title: Rooming with Harry Carney in Freddy Guy's apartment, Duke Ellington downstairs
summary: After a week they moved to Freddy Guy's apartment, paying about four dollars a week, with Ellington always in the apartment below.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, at this point now you'd moved out of Mrs. Carney's friend's...
Well, we didn't stay there but a week or so anyway. We was livin' up here with Freddy Guy.
I see. You moved into Freddy Guy's apartment.
Yeah. Well, Harry and I, we still had... We were roommates, you know. And I had plenty of money. I mean, I wasn't worried about no money for them four weeks. And then right after that...
Was Freddy Guy living alone in that apartment?
So both of you had rooms in this apartment, and you were paying Freddy Guy to live there.
Yeah. I think we were paying about four dollars a week.
And then you said Duke Ellington lived above or below.
Below. Well, he was always in the apartment. It was just like his apartment. Because Freddy and him were real tight, you know. Duke was always up there.
